description: Trigger rules for authorization and representation relationships other than standard agency. When specific relationship types are detected, the AI must direct the user to contact FrontCounter BC for clarification.

knowledge_items.title: Contact FrontCounter BC for Non-Standard Relationships
knowledge_items.instruction: If any of the keywords are detected in a user query related to authorization, roles, or representation, the assistant must direct the user to contact FrontCounter BC for clarification. This rule overrides standard FAQ responses.
knowledge_items.content: For clarification on authorization requirements, please contact FrontCounter BC.
